captions.cftc: CFTC as of Tuesday, published Friday; managed money includes discretionary funds (not only CTAs); crowding context, not a forecast.
captions.trend: Trend proxy = average sign of 1/3/12-month returns on front-month closes (roll gaps not adjusted); describes what trend followers likely hold, not a forecast.
captions.validation: unvalidated: not yet checked against GPR/EPU or a headline audit
captions.rule: Descriptive only: no component is a signal until it passes the quant-research gate.
captions.instruments: Source column: GDELT GKG = BigQuery, phrases matched in each article's title or URL path (GKG path = URL path only); GDELT GKG v2 = BigQuery, the narrative's v2 definition (title or URL-path words and GDELT themes tagged from the full text); GDELT DOC = the DOC API, full text. Each narrative reads one source, never a mix.
captions.gdelt: News data: The GDELT Project, https://www.gdeltproject.org/

captions.model: Risk model: daily log returns of front-month closes (Yahoo continuous contracts, roll gaps not adjusted) spliced with spot/index proxies where a contract has no close (flagged). Current vol = EWMA 0.94; calm correlation = last 250 days; stress correlation = the top-20% turbulence days of the whole history; both shrunk toward constant correlation (Ledoit & Wolf).
captions.stress: Stress P&L in R from today's marks. Replays run day by day: 'stops honoured' exits at the first close beyond the stop (a gap can cost more than 1R); 'gapped' holds to the end. Instantaneous shocks cap honoured losses at the stop. k = plausibility: the scenario's Mahalanobis distance under the stress matrix (scaled to its length), converted to a one-market sd equivalent, so 3 is about as rare as a 3-sd move in one market. Stress tests are not early warnings (Borio et al.).
captions.cta: Prices at which a simple 1/3/12-month trend model would flip sign: describes likely systematic positioning, not a forecast. Published evidence finds trend-flow price pressure small (about 0.2% a week) and fading or reversing within about 4 weeks (Kang, Rouwenhorst & Tang).
captions.crowding: CFTC levels mostly restate past returns (returns lead positions in 10 of 10 markets: Sanders, Irwin & Merrin). Crowding is context; it turns red only when funding is stressing. No crowding or CTA flag alerts unless the research loop (agent 12) rates it supported; its measured verdicts are listed under the CTA table.
captions.rule: Descriptive only: no component is a signal until it passes the quant-research gate. Suggestions and decisions stay with the PM.
